skills.name: Goal review
skills.description: Review open goals, attach evidence, and close the goals whose items and criteria are complete.
skills.scope: goal lifecycle review across the board, items and definition of done
skills.killCriterion: Retire to inline prose when fewer than half of the relevant fixture sessions load it.

skills.name: Handoff triage
skills.description: Triage the handoff ledger: complete delivered work, revert accepted work, and reassign stalled work.
skills.scope: handoff lifecycle triage across the board, timeline and ledger
skills.killCriterion: Retire to inline prose when fewer than half of the relevant fixture sessions load it.

skills.name: Context continue
skills.description: Pack the current session, read the pack back, and continue the work in a successor session.
skills.scope: portable context handoff across pack, read and continue
skills.killCriterion: Retire to inline prose when fewer than half of the relevant fixture sessions load it.

skills.name: Integration engineer

skills.killCriterion: Retire to inline prose when fewer than half of the relevant fixture sessions load it.
